description_en: Stops a running task in a specified ROS Agent V2 session
description_zh: 用于停止指定ROS Agent V2会话中正在执行的任务
name: StopChat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to stop. The operation verifies that the session belongs to the current user
parameters.help_zh: 要停止的会话 ID。接口会校验该会话属于当前用户
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to V2 to route to the ROS Agent V2 backend
parameters.help_zh: 传 V2 路由到 ROS Agent V2 后端
parameters.name: agent_version
